name: Ilok–Bačka Palanka Bridge
facts: Opened in 1974, the Ilok–Bačka Palanka Bridge earned its original name, the "25 May" Bridge, commemorating Josip Broz Tito's birthday on May 25th, a nod to Yugoslav history.
During NATO's 1999 bombing campaign, the bridge sustained airplane bomb damage on April 4th, yet it was rebuilt and reopened for heavy vehicles on April 30, 2002.
Stretching 825 meters as a single‑carriageway box girder, the bridge serves as a vital border crossing, linking Croatia's D2 road terminal to Serbia's M18 corridor.
